title: Commands and events are routed separately
description: Verifies that a command with the same name as an event does not cross over; each registration receives only its type.
given: A client with both on() and onCommand() listeners for the same name
when: Both a command and an event with that name arrive
then: on() receives only the event, onCommand() receives only the command
impl_ref: packages/bridge/src/client.test.ts::does not deliver a command to on(), or an event to onCommand()
